stem.text: A car is accelerated by a constant resultant force of $300\,\text{N}$ for $5.0\,\text{s}$.
The variation with time of the velocity, in $\text{cm s}^{-1}$, of the car is shown.

stem.alt: Graph of velocity /cm s^-1 against time /s. Vertical axis labelled velocity /cm s^-1 from 0 to 180; horizontal axis labelled time /s from 0 to 5. A straight line with dashed guide lines.

stem.text: What is the mass of the car?
